core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abid corresponds to the Arabic form عابد and is glossed in this record as “Worshipper, devout servant.” The record associates the form with root ع ب د (ʿ-b-d). The record identifies the form as an active participle. The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abid corresponds to Arabic عَابِد (ʿābid), associated with the root ع ب د and the verb عَبَدَ, “to worship/serve.” “Worshipper” is the direct lexical gloss; “devout servant” is a contextual rendering. This lexical meaning alone does not establish personal-name frequency or religious prescription.
